cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Count What I Did
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you call that a quick shop, I carried twelve bags up six flights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I know. Sit down; I'll put everything away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Thank you. The frozen peas came up separately. That was a second trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you sit down twice. I'll make tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you tell everyone why I'm getting two rests? Otherwise it looks like one long sit.

mechanism: A authorizes rest and its public explanation only after the helper acknowledges the separate practical efforts being counted.
confusable: D09 seeks general importance; D33 specifically wants time, labor or inconvenience counted, so actual trips and work must drive the acknowledgment.
comparison: Supportive grocery recovery seeks public recognition of two trips; fence work resists a recommendation that would obscure the time spent.
seedUse: Use D33-a second trip and two-rest offer, making S01 permission shape how helpful care becomes acknowledged contribution.
